description_en: Queries the information about the logs of a service
description_zh: 获取指定服务的日志信息
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-service-log --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name echo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceLog

parameters.help_zh: 服务日志的页码，默认为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的日志行数，默认值为500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the instance whose logs you want to query. For more information about how to query the IP address of an instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的机器IP。如何获取机器IP，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The keyword that you use to query the logs of the service
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何获取服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance that runs the service. For more information about how to query the instance name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务实例的名称。如何获取实例名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the container that runs the service
parameters.name: container_name

parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: previous
